statement: The finitely Y-convex functions are dense in the space of Y-convex functions: closure(FC^Y(X)) = C^Y(X).
assumptions: X and Y are compact subsets of Euclidean spaces
the surplus kernel Phi is uniformly Lipschitz on X x Y
the closure is taken in the uniform norm
quantifiers: For every epsilon > 0 and every f in C^Y(X), there is a finite Y~ subset Y and g in C^{Y~}(X) with ||f-g||_infinity < epsilon.
full_credit_gate: A machine-checkable proof certificate, independently reconstructed symbolic derivation covering the exact quantifiers, exhaustive complete-domain check when the domain is finite, or an assumption-satisfying counterexample.
